items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: some people are getting a MacArthur Award for $300,00 genius award like Max Roach

ctx.x: I guess one thing we should touch on is, we are here over the next few days celebrating the NEA Jazz Masters, and this 2010 crop of Jazz Masters. You were named an NEA Jazz Master in 2003, so you have been part of this group for some years now, and you have attended some of these events celebrating the Jazz Masters. Can you describe the experience of having that title given to you and being part of that group?

I love the title, “NEA Jazz Master”, and I appreciate what Dana Gioia, the gentleman who just retired, tried to do to give us more visibility and some kind of an equal exposure of other types of music. The other thing is, I found it ludicrous that they call my hero Dizzy Gillespie, a Jazz Master, and would give him $20,000 life achievement when some people are getting a MacArthur Award for $300,00 genius award like Max Roach, or somebody like Ornette Coleman, or somebody like the soprano player that lived in…
